statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and supraventricular tachycardia
A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) is ordered
The service is to characterize the frequency and duration of arrhythmic events
The service is to guide further management of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9, I47.1, I48.0)
The diagnosis codes are I49.9, I47.1, I48.0
The denial reason is CO-22 (care may be covered by another payer per coordination of benefits)
